title: Companion approval/disapproval (e.g. Lys disapproving of killing a wolf that hadn't attacked, then explicitly saying 'leave it, we can go around' for a similar wolf later) is a nice hidden system but is never explained; a player could rack up disapproval for a long while without realizing companions are silently judging combat choices.
